chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him), and he had gathered the people and exhorted them to jihad, but they remained silent for a long time,
so he said (peace be upon him): "What is the matter with you? Have you become dumb?"
A group of them replied: "O Commander of the Faithful, if you go forth, we shall be with you."
Whereupon he said (peace be upon him):
ai.seo_question: Why did the people remain silent when Imam Ali exhorted them to jihad?
ai.summary: This incident, recorded in Nahj al-Balagha, highlights the psychological barrier of fear and the desire for leadership validation among the early Muslims during the Battle of Siffin. The companions' silence reveals their reliance on the Imam's personal presence as a source of courage, a theme central to Shia political theology regarding the role of the Imam as the focal point of communal unity and military mobilization.
